title: Completeness is local for every covering sieve
statement: Let C,J,R,K and all derived categories be as in the complete-element predicate [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element]. For U in C, a covering sieve S on U, and f in R(U), f is complete on U if and only if R(a)(f) is complete for every a:V→U in S.

source.place: Tag 0998, omitted sheaf verification, with sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JB.

proof.text: Apply the localization-Hom restriction comparison. Exact derived restriction preserves zero, so global completeness implies the predicate on every arrow in the sieve.

source.place: Tag 0998, omitted sheaf verification, with sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JB.

proof.text: Conversely, the same comparison shows that the localization-Hom object restricts to zero on the covering sieve. Exact restriction commutes with cohomology; hence each cohomology module sheaf restricts to zero.

source.place: Tag 0998, omitted sheaf verification, with sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JB.

proof.text: A module sheaf on C/U whose restrictions vanish on S is zero. For an object X→U pull back S. On every arrow in this covering sieve the value of the module is zero, detected by the identity object in the corresponding slice. Every section therefore agrees locally with zero, and separatedness makes it zero. This works for empty covering sieves.

source.place: Tag 0998, omitted sheaf verification, with sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JB.

proof.text: The cohomology functors jointly reflect zero objects in the derived category, so the original Hom object is zero.

theorem ringedSite_complete_element_local
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).over U))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))) (U : C) (S : Sieve U) (hS : S ∈ J U)
    (f : R.obj.obj (op U)) :
    IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U f ↔
      ∀ (V : C) (a : V ⟶ U), S a →
        IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K V (R.obj.map a.op f)
